rule: the fit starts from a Stage 1 G5 selection: env.tuned_gains (env.GAINS_RULE) on <Stage 1 run>/<start body>/tune.json, the start body being the body itself when it has a Stage 1 fit (<Stage 1 run>/<body>/tune.json) and otherwise (a faster-knee body) the pick it is built from, its round-two candidate id (the registry's candidate_id); --start-from may name that start body and no other; refused unless that selection passed G5 and holds the fixed gains (tune.FIXED_GAINS); the start is recorded once per body (speedfit/start.json: the record's path and sha256, the candidate and its gains) and every seed and session must start from it
source: 60-N-H-10's Stage 1 G5 selection (tune.json: CMA-ES seed 43's G5 selection seed43_gen60)
gains_rule: R3's tracker gains are tune.json's body-level G5 selection: of the CMA-ES seeds whose selected candidate passes G5 (seeds[s].pass_ true), the one whose selection ranks first by tune.SELECTION_RULE's key on its validation episodes (fewer falls, then the lower mean S, mean P and mean J; then the lower seed); both PPO seeds train on it.  Without a G5 pass (tune.json missing, G5 failed or not judged) train refuses R3 unless --allow-untuned; the gains are then the same ranking over the judged seeds' selections (flagged 'G5 failed' or 'G5 not judged') or, with none, the tuning start (decision 16, flagged 'untuned')
